title: Vaccine
summary: VAC'CINE, adjective [Latin vaccinus, from vacca, a cow.] Pertaining to cows; originating with or derived from cows; as the vaccine disease or cow-pox.

inlines.v: VAC'CINE, adjective [Latin vaccinus, from vacca, a cow.] Pertaining to cows; originating with or derived from cows; as the vaccine disease or cow-pox.
